summary: Adams County, OH tower reported in 1934 as 73 feet tall, about a mile from Mineral Springs; FFLOS-registered 2014 as US 1568; now listed as gone.

facts.status_note: Listed as 'Tower Gone' on the Forest Fire Lookout Association's Ohio list; no removal date or site description found

notes_for_editor: Only two dated 1934 newspaper extracts (carried on the Forest Lookouts site) describe the tower. No source gives the construction date, the removal date, or what stands at the site now. The 'Adam County' spelling is the newspaper's own and is kept in the quote. The Wikipedia page gives 1868-1919 for the post office and Salt Magazine gives 1872 for it; neither is used in the story. The FFLOS page has no narrative text, only registry fields. No NHLR entry was checked. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the 1934 entry is 'other', not 'built', because the Gazette reports an opening announcement and no construction date.
